# Multi Select

## Summary
The multiple-selection dropdown, with chosen values shown as removable pills.

## Shape
Same option and selection contract as `BoxelSelect` over power-select's multiple mode, so
`@selected` is an array. Each choice renders as a pill carrying its own remove affordance,
which means deselection does not require reopening the dropdown — the difference that matters
most when a selection is long. `BoxelMultiSelectBasic` is exported for callers that want the
behavior without the pill presentation.

## Usage
Rendered in its states by the freestyle usage page at `packages/boxel-ui/src/components/multi-select/usage.gts`.

```gts
import { BoxelMultiSelect } from '@cardstack/boxel-ui/components';
```
